load_mag_dataset_arrays: load all MAG dataset arrays including paper labels, train valid test indices, adjacency matrices, and PCA embeddings from a data root directory
create_graph_subsampling_dataset: create a tensorflow dataset for online graph subsampling using the MAG adjacency matrices and a specified ratio of unlabeled to labeled data
generate_k_fold_splits: generate k-fold train and validation split files by partitioning the validation set and adding fractions back to training
build_fused_paper_adjacency: build a fused paper adjacency matrix by merging edges between identical paper nodes detected via zero neighbor distances
propagate_fused_node_labels: propagate paper labels between identical nodes by assigning training node labels to their matching neighbors that are not in validation or test sets
